scenes.title: The hospital refused the Ayushman card.
lines: Or asked for a deposit, medicines, tests.
Or said it is not in the scheme.
Ayushman Sahayak shows what PM-JAY says
and what to do, in English and Hindi.
scenes.say: At the hospital counter, a family with Ayushman Bharat cover is told the card does not work, or is asked to pay for medicines and tests. Ayushman Sahayak shows what the scheme says and what to do, in English and Hindi.

scenes.title: Three taps, no personal data
lines: Where are you, what happened,
anyone aged 70 or older.
It never asks for Aadhaar, the card,
a phone number or a name.
scenes.say: Three taps: before going, admitted or discharged, what happened, and whether anyone in the family is seventy or older. It never asks for Aadhaar, the card number or a phone number.

scenes.title: The rule, with its official source
lines: After admission, tests, medicines and implants
are part of the package (CAG audit 2023).
Empanelled hospitals cannot deny treatment
(Lok Sabha answer, PIB 2243769).
scenes.say: Asked to pay while admitted? The CAG audit quotes the hospital agreement: after admission, tests, medicines and implants are part of the package. And empanelled hospitals cannot deny treatment. Every rule links its official source. When it is urgent, a red bar says call fourteen five five five now.

scenes.title: A request to show at the PM-JAY desk
lines: Hindi or English, blanks filled by hand.
Copy, WhatsApp, or read aloud.
Then the official complaint routes:
14555, CGRMS, Ayushman App, Sarathi.
scenes.say: Then a short request to show at the PM-JAY desk, with the rule cited, and the official complaint routes: the toll free helpline, the CGRMS portal, the Ayushman app and Ayushman Sarathi on WhatsApp. It never promises free treatment or a refund.

scenes.title: Works on a cheap phone
lines: Under 100 KB, no install, no account.
Every rule quoted word for word from the source;
10 real court and consumer cases replayed.
scenes.say: It works on a cheap phone with no install. Fifty seven tests guard the rules, each rule is checked word for word against its official source, and ten real court and consumer commission cases are replayed through it.

scenes.title: Impact, counted in public
lines: ayushman-sahayak.designmaster.workers.dev/stats
Results, requests copied or shared,
and "Did it work?" answers.
No personal data.
scenes.say: Every result, every request shared and every did it work answer is counted in public, without personal data. Ayushman Sahayak, free and open source.
